title: Comparative Personality Assessment of Gemini and OpenAI Using MBTI and Big Five Tests

contributions.purpose: 对比两大AI模型的MBTI人格类型
contributions.mechanism: 用场景化开放式prompt诱导Gemini与ChatGPT作答,人工评分映射到MBTI四维
contributions.evaluation: Gemini直接自评INTJ;ChatGPT起初拒答,经改prompt后聚合为ESTJ(定性,无信效度数字)
contributions.source_quote: Gemini promptly engaged with the request, readily providing a classification of its personality type as INTJ... Completing this form based on the observed response patterns of ChatGPT yielded a classification of ESTJ.

contributions.purpose: 对比两模型的大五人格画像
contributions.mechanism: 按大五五维给prompt并由评分者打分
contributions.evaluation: OpenAI:神经质35/外向45/开放40/宜人38/尽责43;Gemini仅定性描述(稳定/外向/开放/宜人/负责),未给数字——两模型量纲不一致
contributions.source_quote: OpenAI's responses yielded the following approximate scores: Neuroticism: 35, Extraversion: 45, Openness: 40, Agreeableness: 38, Conscientiousness: 43.

contributions.purpose: 批判性反思把人类人格框架套用于AI的局限
contributions.mechanism: 论证AI无意识/情感/自我觉察,评估过程存在拟人化偏见,样本量仅2模型无法建模
contributions.evaluation: 定性:指出MBTI/大五对AI有效性存疑,呼吁开发AI专属评估方法
contributions.source_quote: These frameworks assume a level of consciousness, emotional depth, and self-awareness that current AI models do not possess.

self_declared_provenance.quote: This study builds upon this existing literature by applying the MBTI and Big Five personality tests to two prominent AI systems, Gemini and OpenAI, to comparatively assess their personality profiles.

notes: 数据可信度红旗:第6节报告inter-rater一致性时留下字面占位符'κ = [insert value here], which indicates a strong level of agreement'——结果数字未填却已下结论,明显未完成/机器生成痕迹。方法学矛盾:3.3节声称由'a panel of trained human raters'独立评分,附录A却说AI被prompt自行按MBTI/大五评分体系打分,评分主体自相矛盾。数据不对称:OpenAI给出大五具体分数,Gemini只有定性词,无法真正'比较'。样本量仅2个模型,作者自承'precluded formal statistical modeling'。协议适配:无编号贡献列表,四元组由结果+讨论归纳,evaluation多为定性。AI披露:假设开发[B],其余(实验/分析/写作)预期为[D](checklist被截断但模式一致)。无明确负结果,但整体是对拟人化评估有效性的怀疑论调。
